primary_work.title: Test-Time Learning of Causal Structure from Interventional Data
primary_work.code_status: no paper-specific immutable official repository with pinned dependencies and reproduction commands verified from the inspected primary records

decision: NARROWED BEYOND UNKNOWN-TARGET JCI / TEST-TIME CAUSAL DISCOVERY — NOT ADOPTED
rejected_claims: unknown intervention targets require language for recovery
multi-variable or soft unknown interventions are inherently outside non-language causal discovery
intervention-target detection proves identification of raw utterance equivalence
test-time adaptation is itself a language-grounding principle
I-CPDAG or target-detection accuracy proves recovery of a semantic latent target partition
language adds identifiability when it merely names a JCI context or already detected target
remaining_rq: After conditioning on the strongest non-language unknown-target causal-discovery statistic, can a preregistered externally fixed language law distinguish a residual target partition, jointly identify raw-utterance equivalence, and eliminate every joint relabeling of target blocks, utterance classes, and context labels?
